scrappa-skill 0.1.0 changelog

- Initial release of Scrappa MCP Skill.
- Provides access to 80+ search and data tools for Google, YouTube, Amazon, LinkedIn, Trustpilot, flights, hotels, real estate, and more via Scrappa's Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
- Includes detailed setup and configuration guides for integration.
- Lists all available tool endpoints and usage examples for each platform.
- Requires a Scrappa API key and supports advanced search features and filters.
